inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, what we are witnessing right now is a chilling escalation of state intimidation aimed squarely at marginalized communities and the very foundation of our democratic process. Let's be entirely clear about what is happening beneath the rhetoric of "secure borders" and "civic duties." On Tuesday, White House border czar Tom Homan appeared on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” where he openly refused to rule out deploying immigration enforcement directly to polling places. 

This isn't about accountability or the rule of law; it is a blatant, systemic effort to suppress votes and terrorize vulnerable, racialized populations who are simply trying to exercise their fundamental rights. By threatening to station armed immigration agents at the ballot box, the administration is weaponizing the machinery of the state to enforce fear and exclusion, proving once again that their priority is maintaining power through intimidation rather than democratic engagement. When those in power demand to know what Democrats are "afraid of," they are deliberately ignoring the historic and ongoing disenfranchisement of working-class people and immigrants of color. We must recognize this for what it is: an authoritarian attack on labor rights, civil liberties, and the foundational principle that every person deserves to live and participate in society free from state-sponsored harassment.
